text.description_html:
SOSS 203, Satin Stainless Steel Invisible Door Hinge

SOSS 203 hinges are for use on 3/4" thick wood doors or metal doors. Package includes one (1) hinge with matching finish #6 x 1" wood screws. When the door is closed, SOSS Invisible Hinges cannot be seen or tampered with. When opened, the riveted hinge pin is non-removable. The installed hinge is firmly anchored in a deep, full mortise, which assists the screws in supporting the door, assuring a stronger door hinge installation.

Also Available For: 1" Thick Doors SOSS 208 Hinge, 1-3/4" Thick Doors SOSS 218 Hinge, 1-3/8" Thick Doors SOSS 216 Hinge, and 2" Thick Doors SOSS 220 Hinge

Features and Specifications of the Concealed Cabinet Door Hinges:

  • For use on wood or metal doors.
  • Hinges open a full 180°
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Specifications of the SOSS 203 Invisible Hinges:

  • Hinge Material: High Strength 316 Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Total Height: 1-3/4"
  • Leaf Plate Width: 1/2"
  • Minimum Door Thickness: 3/4" Thick Door
  • Wood Screws: #6x1" (3.5x25mm)

*Sold Individually (1 Door Hinge)
